title: Shipped a 3D game to both stores with an agent: what actually worked, and what it cannot do
author: mohamnag
selftext:
Tanks 1945, a top-down tank game in Godot 4.7, now in open testing on Android with the iOS build in review. Built with Claude Code doing most of the typing. The parts worth reporting are the ones that changed how the work was organised.



\*\*Models are generated, not modelled.\*\* Every tank, wall, tree and pickup comes out of Python scripts in Blender, with shared helpers holding the style. That is what makes an agent useful on art: a script is deterministic, re-runnable, diffable and consistent across a whole kit, where a generated mesh is none of those. The limit is exactly where rigging starts — this works for a tank with a rotating turret and would not survive a character that needs a walk cycle.



\*\*Headless tests are the verification loop.\*\* Godot runs a script with no window, so every gameplay rule has a test the agent can run itself: payout arithmetic, AI behaviour, save handling, the store's purchase path. Around forty of them. That is the difference between an agent that guesses and one that can check.



\*\*Visual work needs a different loop, and it is the one thing that cannot be automated.\*\* Every new visual goes on a showcase scene first and is approved there, one change at a time, with a render sent each time. Trying to batch five visual changes and review at the end wastes all five.



\*\*The store work was most of the calendar time and none of the fun.\*\* Two listings, every questionnaire, billing on both platforms, signing, tax and trader status. An agent is genuinely good at this — it is reading rules carefully and filling forms exactly — and it is also where the expensive bugs were. The one that cost real money: both store plugins return \`PackedStringArray\`, not \`Array\`, and a guard written \`ids as Array if ids is Array else \[\]\` is false for a packed array, so a purchase was charged, never credited and never consumed. It printed in the log exactly like a success.



Happy to go into any of it. The game, if you want to see what it produced: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.techsnap.steelcadence.tanks1945](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.techsnap.steelcadence.tanks1945)
